justification: All three headline claims are quantitatively reproduced. C1: spin polarization P(x)=+0.931 and P(y)=-0.931, confirming exact sign reversal with bias direction as expected for d-wave altermagnet. C2: diagonal bias yields P_long=0.0 and nonzero transverse spin current (-146266) with zero transverse charge current, confirming the non-relativistic spin-splitter effect. C3: FM gives identical polarization (~0.117) for all bias directions; conventional AFM gives P=0 for all directions. All mechanisms and symmetry signatures match the paper's Fig. 1 conceptual model precisely.
caveats: Replication uses a minimal tight-binding constant-tau Boltzmann model; material-specific TMR/AHE magnitudes and THz dynamics are review-level surveys explicitly noted as out of scope and not tested.
